## What and why

Say what changed and why. Link an issue with "Fixes #123" when you have one.

## Screenshots

Required when the UI changes. Show the before and after.

## Checklist

- [ ] No secrets, tokens, consumer key values, or `.env` files
- [ ] Screenshots attached when the UI changes
- [ ] If the branch contains the app, `swift build` and `scripts/test.sh` pass on a Mac
